def: something round, i.e. a ring (for the ears)

occurrences.text: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.
And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
